info.title: ikon
info.description: Ikon Tool is a command-line utility that is used for login, project creation, pipeline running, and more.

options.name: --space-id
options.description: Space ID to use for space-scoped backend token

options.name: --reset
options.description: Reset the Ikon tool by clearing all user data

options.name: --disable-auto-login
options.description: Disable auto login to the Ikon platform

options.name: --all-keys
options.description: Request all API keys from the backend (admin only)

options.name: --low-memory
options.description:
Trade speed for lower peak memory on constrained hosts
Authentication
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
login [environment]                                Log in to the Ikon platform
logout [environment]                               Log out from the Ikon platform
status                                             Show the current login status
Project
load [ref] [environment]                           Download a Studio project and set it up for local development
Configuration
defaults [environment]                             Set the default environment, organisation and space used by commands
General
examples [action]                                  Open or download Ikon example projects
update                                             Update the Ikon tool to the latest version
version                                            Print the current version of the Ikon tool
Commands (use 'ikon <command>' for details)
auth ...                                           Service tokens and signed-in machines (sign in with 'ikon login') (6 commands)
dev ...                                            Dev commands (3 commands)
install ...                                        Install developer prerequisites (.NET, Node.js, Flutter) (7 commands)
tool ...                                           Tool package commands (3 commands)
Run 'ikon help --json' for every verb with its options and positionals, machine-readable
